YTC — a reissued certificate mid-series (Mayo Autumn Series 2026, HalSail parity)

Mayo Sailing Club's 2026 Autumn Series for its Cruisers YTC fleet, as published on HalSail (halsail.com/Result/Public/96884). Crozz sailed races 1–3 on YTC 920 and races 4–6 on 941, the number on its reissued RORC certificate. Crozz carries its current number, 941; races 1–3 are pinned to 920 with a per-race rating override on the ytcNumber field, the same mechanism as a new IRC certificate. The override decides race 1: on 941 Crozz would correct to 0:32:53 and win it, not finish third on 0:33:38. Every corrected time matches HalSail's to the second. Freebird and Elixir, who came to no race, finish level on 29 and stay tied (HalSail's "6=").

Scoring system: YTC 
Mayo scores DNC as the boats that came to the start + 1, like DNF.
Standings exactly as HalSail publishes them; "(…)" there is a discard here.
